6523329.name: Chabad of Cozumel Mexico
6523329.note: Cozumel had a Jewish community 'but not a very active one ... until January 2009, when Chabad opened its doors'; 'Rabbi David Caplin and Rabbi Shalom Peleg' (YeahThatsKosher, a Cozumel resident's article of 29 Dec 2010). Agreeing: Rabbi Shlomo Peleg 'arrived four years ago' (Jewish Independent, 20 Sept 2013, https://jewishindependent.ca/oldsite/archives/sept13/archives13sept20-07.html; the idea came from the family behind Diamonds International); 'Cozumel Supporters Mark 10 Years' (ChabadInfo, 2 Dec 2019); the Caplins 'have led the Chabad House for 16 years' (CrownHeights.info, 19 Aug 2025, https://crownheights.info/chabad-news/918378/history-in-mexico-a-new-torah-scroll-in-cozumel/). Against, slightly: 'opened by Rabbi Dudi Caplin in 5770, fourteen years ago, along with his friend, Rabbi Shlomi Peleg' (ChabadInfo, 15 Jan 2024, https://chabadinfo.com/magazine/how-the-mexican-coast-guard-was-removed-from-the-cozumel-chabad-house/: 5770 began in Sept 2009) and a GoKosher listing's 2008; so the month is left out. The 2024 piece calls it the first Chabad House in Central America for Israeli tourists; it found a neglected government building at first and was pushed out of it by the Coast Guard about two years later. In Dec 2010 the Chabad House was on Calle 12 between Rafael Melgar and 5th Avenue; by Sept 2013 it had moved from its first small premises to 'a larger, 200-square-metre space upstairs in the central village courtyard'; today 5a Avenida Sur and Calle 1 Sur. Rabbi Caplin was recognized as Chief Rabbi of Quintana Roo in Nov 2025.

earlier.where: Calle 12, between Avenida Rafael Melgar and 5th Avenue, downtown Cozumel, six blocks from the ferry pier (as described in Dec 2010)

people.name: Rabbi Dudi Caplin
people.note: 'Rabbi David Caplin' in Dec 2010; 'opened by Rabbi Dudi Caplin' (ChabadInfo, 2024)

people.name: Rabbi Shlomi Peleg
people.note: 'Rabbi Shalom Peleg' (Dec 2010), 'Rabbi Shlomo Peleg and his wife Noy' (Sept 2013)

people.name: Chani Caplin
people.note: 'Rabbi Dudi and Chani Caplin, who have led the Chabad House for 16 years' (Aug 2025)

334161.name: Chabad Baja California
334161.note: 'Before Yom Kippur in the year 1993, Mendel received the blessing and consent of Rabbi Menachem Mendel Schneerson' to become the rabbi of Tijuana's Jewish community, the first official Chabad shliach in Mexico (Chabad of Chula Vista's About page; ordained at Kfar Chabad in 1993). 'Polichenco, a native of Buenos Aires, Argentina, opened the Tijuana Chabad in 1993, moving into a building on Avenida 16 de Septiembre, which the Jewish community built in 1965' (Jewish Journal, 17 Apr 2014, https://jewishjournal.com/cover_story/128468/). lubavitch.com's directory, Aug 2011: 'Chabad Tijuana, Av. 16 de Septiembre #18 Col. Gabilondo' (https://web.archive.org/web/20110819022933/http://lubavitch.com/centers/list.html?Country=Mexico). He ran a Jewish day school there 1997-2004, founded Chabad of Chula Vista in 2004 and Chabad Without Borders, which set up the Cabo San Lucas and La Paz branches (Del Mar Times via ChabadInfo, 14 Sept 2014). A Baja California dot of the West Coast shetach (Mexico).

503725.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Cancun
503725.note: Rabbi Mendel and Rachel Druk and their baby moved from Crown Heights to Cancun on Monday 2 July 2007 (Chabad.org, Fri 6 July 2007: 'the Druks' move last Monday'; the community's president picked them up at the airport), seeded by a Sami Rohr grant. Same in CrownHeights.info, 11 July 2007 ('have just moved to Cancun'), the NY Daily News, 24 July 2007 ('arrived in Cancun three weeks ago') and JTA, 18 July 2007. A 2012 Times of Israel profile's 'beginning of 2006' is wrong. lubavitch.com's directory, Aug 2011: 'Ave Antonio Enrikes Savenyak' (Av. Antonio Enriquez Savignac). In March 2012 it broke ground on a 15,000 sq ft center near the beach, dedicated to Dovid Malka (COLlive, 29 Mar 2012); its site now says it has relocated to Kukulkan Plaza, Km 13 of the hotel zone.

earlier.where: Av. Antonio Enriquez Savignac, Cancun ('Ave Antonio Enrikes Savenyak' in lubavitch.com's directory, Aug 2011), before it moved to Kukulkan Plaza, Km 13

844570.name: Cabo Jewish Center
844570.note: 'In March 2009 the Hershcovichs ... arrived to serve the needs of Jewish people in Cabo San Lucas and the greater Baja area' (lubavitch.com, 1 Jan 2010). Announced in Jan 2009 ('will IYH be leaving next month for Los Cabos', CrownHeights.info, 22 Jan 2009); they first visited the last Shabbat of 2008 (Chabad.org, 30 Dec 2021); 'Rabbi Benny's arrival in 2009' (San Diego Jewish World, 13 Mar 2023). Before them, from 2006, Rabbi Mendel Polichenco of Tijuana came once a month (Jewish Journal, 5 Oct 2006: services in Cabo 'over the last year'). lubavitch.com's directory, Dec 2009: 'Miguel Hidalgo Y Ninos Heroes, Cabos S. Lucas'. Its own center, the 21,000 sq ft Eliyahu Hanavi Synagogue near the marina (Camino de la Plaza 135), opened Chanukah 2021 (Chabad.org, https://www.chabad.org/5362402). A Baja California Sur dot of the West Coast shetach (Mexico).

earlier.where: Miguel Hidalgo y Ninos Heroes, Cabo San Lucas (lubavitch.com's directory, Dec 2009)

people.name: Rabbi Mendel Polichenco
people.note: came from Tijuana once a month before the Hershcoviches; his Chabad Without Borders set up the branch

1294865.name: Chabad Lubavitch Jewish Center of Playa Del Carmen
1294865.note: 'The new Chabad-Lubavitch Jewish Center, established just last month by Rabbi Mendel and Chaya Goldberg' (Chabad.org, 25 Oct 2010), from their home, with a banner on its front just before the High Holidays; appointed by Rabbi Moshe Kotlarsky and Rabbi Mendel Druk, who had come weekly from Cancun for three years (COLlive, 26 Oct 2010). First public menorah on 5th Avenue, Chanukah 2010 (COLlive, 9 Dec 2010). In April 2011 they announced a new building 'in the center of town, on the main Avenue' (COLlive, 1 Apr 2011); today 10 Avenida Norte between Calles 6 and 8. A separate Israeli Chabad house of Rabbi Chaim Brod, at Calle 8 and 20 Avenida, opened about Oct 2010 (Juedische Allgemeine, 14 Feb 2011).

earlier.where: the Goldbergs' home, where they began in Sept 2010 (services, classes and meals; a banner on its front)

people.name: Rabbi Mendel Druk
people.note: came from Cancun weekly for three years before the Goldbergs

2502409.name: Jewish La Paz - Beth Yonah Chabad
2502409.note: No start year found. 'Rabbi Alexander and Esther Piekarski, co-directors of Beth Yona-Chabad Jewish Community of La Paz' in Sept 2014 (Chabad.org, Hurricane Odile) and May 2015 (Chabad.org); its chabad.org listing was made about Feb 2014. The Beth Yona synagogue 'was built in 2012 by Daniel Berrebi in memory of his brother, Yona' (Jewish News, 14 Apr 2019; 'financed in 2013 with contributions from local merchants', San Diego Jewish World, 2023), so the center is from 2012-2014, but which year it became Chabad's is not said. Rabbi Mendel Polichenco's Chabad Without Borders set up the La Paz branch (2014). Rabbi Yosef Gutierrez has led it since he returned to La Paz in 2016 (Jewish News, 2019). A Baja California Sur dot of the West Coast shetach (Mexico).

people.name: Daniel Berrebi
people.note: built the Beth Yona synagogue in memory of his brother Yona

3424139.name: Chabad of Puerto Vallarta
3424139.note: 'Rabbi Shneur and Mushkie Hecht, co-directors of Chabad of Puerto Vallarta, came to the resort city in late September with their two young children a week before Rosh Hashanah' (Chabad.org, 11 Jan 2017), and held the holiday in a rented room at the Hilton. Agreeing: 'a little more than two years since' they founded it (Chabad.org, Feb 2019); 'established ... six years ago' (Jerusalem Post, Dec 2022); its site, 2026: 'Celebrating 10 Years of Jewish Life in Puerto Vallarta'. Its chabad.org listing was made in early Sept 2016.

4251108.name: Chabad of SMA
4251108.note: 'Rabbi Daniel and Raizel Huebner, and their three children, moved to the city just before last Chanukah' (lubavitch.com, 28 Mar 2019; Chanukah 2018 began 2 Dec). Announced: 'In November, Rabbi Daniel and Raizel Huebner will move with their three children from New Jersey to San Miguel de Allende' with a traveling Torah from the Teldons; 'The Chabad center will be based out of the Huebners' house near the center of town' (Chabad.org via CrownHeights.info, 17 Oct 2018). Today at Independencia 7.

earlier.where: the Huebners' house near the center of town, where the Chabad center began

6260059.name: Chabad Lubavitch Mexico City
6260059.note: No start year found (Nov 2026 searches in English, Spanish and Hebrew; the family name is also spelled Meislish). By Aug 2018 it was running: Chabad-Lubavitch opened Mexico's first yeshiva on 26 Aug 2018 'under the direction of Rabbi Mendel Mayzlesh, son of Rabbi Yossef Mayzlesh, director of Chabad in Mexico' (Pulse News Mexico, 2 Sept 2018). Its site says only 'Founded in the mid-20th century' (chabadofmexico.com). Its chabad.org listing (Calderon de la Barca 339, Polanco) is from about Dec 2023. Not in lubavitch.com's Mexico directory of Aug 2011 (Tijuana and Cancun only).

people.name: Rabbi Yossef Mayzlesh
people.note: 'director of Chabad in Mexico' (Pulse News Mexico, 2018)

6342563.name: Chabad of Bosques
6342563.note: No dated source found yet (Nov 2026 searches). Rabbi Yosef Y. Mayzlesh, its director, was 'director of Chabad in Mexico' in 2018 (Pulse News Mexico), but no source dates this center. Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about 2024.

6540954.name: Chabad of Tulum
6540954.note: 'In 2019, Rabbi Netanel and Linor Binyamini embarked on a mission to make Judaism and spirituality accessible in Tulum. They established Chabad of Tulum in their small apartment'; it is now a 2,500-meter property with the rabbi's home, a synagogue, a kosher restaurant and a lounge (its own About page). It received its first Torah in Aug 2021 (ChabadInfo, 17 Aug 2021). Today Av. Kukulkan, Mza 57, Lt 3.

earlier.where: the Binyaminis' small apartment in Tulum, where they began

7011671.name: Chabad of Guadalajara
7011671.note: No start year found. 'Rabbi Abraham Srugo is leader of the Chabad of Guadalajara movement'; he 'lived for a brief time in Mexico City where his father was a Rabbi 30 years ago' (Guadalajara Reporter, published 6 July 2012). Rabbi Abraham and Elisheva Srugo co-directors (Chabad.org, Dec 2016). Its old chabad.org center number (8935, next after Playa del Carmen's of 2010) puts its first listing about 2010-2011 (lead only); today's listing (7011671) is from 2025.

people.name: Rabbi Abraham Srugo
people.note: leader of Chabad of Guadalajara (July 2012); with Elisheva Srugo (2016)

7022006.name: Chabad Of Chiapas
7022006.note: 'The Raz family, Oren, Einat and their six children, have been on Shlichus for five years' (ChabadInfo, 31 Mar 2016, from Beis Moshiach), counted back: 2011. Rabbis Dudi Caplin and Shlomi Peleg of Cozumel checked San Cristobal out for them and rented them a house; their first holiday with tourists was Rosh Hashanah. 'Until two years ago, we lived in a rickety wooden building. We ran the Chabad House from that small house'; by 2016 'an active Chabad House in a spacious building in the center of town' (today Avenida Ignacio Allende 7, Barrio de la Merced). A ChabadInfo photo post of 18 Feb 2020 is titled 'New Shluchim to Chiapas, Mexico' (no text). Its chabad.org listing is from 2025.

earlier.where: the Razes' first home, a small wooden house rented for them by the Cozumel shluchim, from which they ran the Chabad House (until about 2014)

7097150.name: Chabad of Lake Chapala
7097150.note: No start year found. 'Rabbi Abraham and Elisheva Srugo, who direct Chabad of Lake Chapala in Jalisco' (COLlive, 22 Feb 2026). Its co-director Yossi Suares 'completed his training as a Community Rav in 2024' (chabadajijic.com). Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about Oct-Nov 2025. (The Lake Chapala Jewish Congregation, from 2000, is a separate, non-Chabad shul.)

7338776.name: Jabad Monterrey
7338776.note: No start year found. World Cup activities in July 2026 were led 'by Zalmy Srugo in Monterrey', a city 'home to active Chabad centers' (COLlive, 13 July 2026). Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about Apr-June 2026.

people.name: Zalmy Srugo
people.note: Rabbi Shneor Zalmen Srugo on its chabad.org listing

7423203.name: CTEEN Cancun
7423203.note: No dated source found yet (Nov 2026 searches). The CTeen chapter of Chabad of Cancun (Rabbi Mendel Druk). Lead: the chabad.org listing is from about July 2026.

extra-mexico-mazatlan.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Mazatlán
extra-mexico-mazatlan.note: 'Rabbi Chaim and Tzirl Raitport together with their son will be moving on Shlichus to Mazatlan' (COLlive, Chof Av = 2 Aug 2026), the first shluchim in Sinaloa. 'The Raitports have already gone to visit for yomim Tovim': 'an incredible turnout on Purim and the Shabbos that followed' (Purim 2026 = 3 Mar). Medium: earlier yom tov visits may go back to 2025.
